label: Several keys per provider: which failures move a call to the next key, and when a key comes back
description_nl: A person may keep several keys for one provider (free-tier Gemini keys from a few accounts, a spare paid one). A call goes to the default key first, then the next usable one. Which error means what is chip providers.failure_kind; whether a marked key may be tried again is chip providers.key_usable (an exhausted key after revive_minutes; an invalid one only after a test passes). keys_max: keys one person may keep per provider. name_default: the name a key gets when none is typed. name_max: the longest label a key may carry (the account it came from, so a limit message names the one to top up). test_prompt: what a Test sends to an OpenAI-shaped provider.
weight_basis: The rotation policy. Edit it here, never in Python.
